## About the tables

These tables provide a single reference point for **cardiovascular disease (CVD) statistics in Barbados**. They bring together annual, quarterly and monthly counts of registered CVD events and CVD deaths, together with distributions, population rates and two simple indicators that help explain how the national estimates are constructed.

The tables update when new approved event or mortality data are released. Event and mortality releases may cover different periods, so the latest period available can differ between sections. Where a period is incomplete, it is clearly identified rather than treated as a complete year, quarter or month.

Use the tabs within each table to move between CVD groups or definitions. Every tab has its own **Download table** button, and tables with several tabs also have a **Download all tabs** button that saves the whole tab set as one CSV file. Downloaded table CSVs include a small set of provenance fields identifying the source release, metric and metadata reference. Quarterly and monthly tables are grouped under collapsible year headings rather than adding another layer of year tabs; the two most recent years are open by default.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
schemaCheck = {
  const requiredEvent = [
    "metric_id", "release_id", "period_type", "period_year", "period_month", "period_quarter", "period_complete",
    "event_type", "sex", "age_group", "source_status", "ascertainment_scope",
    "mortality_definition", "estimate_basis", "statistic", "value", "display_value",
    "ci_lower_value", "ci_upper_value", "suppression_status"
  ];
  const requiredMortality = [
    "metric_id", "release_id", "period_type", "period_year", "period_month", "period_quarter", "period_complete",
    "event_type", "sex", "age_group", "case_definition", "source_status",
    "statistic", "value", "display_value", "ci_lower_value", "ci_upper_value",
    "suppression_status"
  ];

  function requireColumns(data, columns, label) {
    if (!data.length) throw new Error(`${label}: public dataset is empty.`);
    const available = new Set(Object.keys(data[0]));
    const missing = columns.filter(d => !available.has(d));
    if (missing.length) throw new Error(`${label}: missing required columns: ${missing.join(", ")}`);
  }

  function requireMetrics(data, ids, label) {
    const available = new Set(data.map(d => d.metric_id));
    const missing = ids.filter(d => !available.has(d));
    if (missing.length) throw new Error(`${label}: missing required metric families: ${missing.join(", ")}`);
  }

  requireColumns(eventMetrics, requiredEvent, "CVD event tables");
  requireColumns(eventMonthlyReference, [
    "schema_version", "ascertainment_scope", "event_type", "sex", "age_group", "period_month",
    "reference_start_year", "reference_end_year", "reference_min", "reference_mean", "reference_max"
  ], "CVD event monthly reference");
  requireColumns(mortalityMetrics, requiredMortality, "CVD mortality tables");
  requireColumns(mortalityMonthlyReference, [
    "case_definition", "event_type", "sex", "age_group", "period_month",
    "reference_start_year", "reference_end_year", "reference_n",
    "reference_min", "reference_mean", "reference_max"
  ], "CVD mortality monthly reference");
  requireMetrics(eventMetrics, ["CVD-BURDEN-001", "CVD-BURDEN-002", "CVD-INCIDENCE-001"], "CVD event tables");
  requireMetrics(mortalityMetrics, ["MORT-BURDEN-001", "MORT-BURDEN-002", "MORT-RATE-001"], "CVD mortality tables");
  return true;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// SHARED TABLE HELPERS
// These helpers format already-published values and construct HTML tables.
// The only calculations performed here are the two explicitly approved
// dashboard-aligned quality indicators defined later in eventViews/mortalityViews.
tableUtils = {
  const missingValues = new Set(["", ".", "NA", "N/A", "null", "undefined"]);
  const monthNames = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];

  function isMissing(value) {
    return value === null || value === undefined || missingValues.has(String(value).trim());
  }

  function isSuppressed(row) {
    if (!row) return false;
    const status = String(row.suppression_status ?? "none").trim().toLowerCase();
    return status !== "" && status !== "none" && status !== "not_applicable";
  }

  function publishedDisplay(row, digits = 1, integer = false) {
    if (!row) return "—";
    if (isSuppressed(row)) {
      if (!isMissing(row.display_value)) return String(row.display_value);
      return "Suppressed";
    }
    if (isMissing(row.display_value)) return "—";
    const value = Number(row.display_value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return String(row.display_value);
    if (integer) return Math.round(value).toLocaleString("en-GB");
    return value.toFixed(digits);
  }

  function rateWithCI(row) {
    if (!row) return "—";
    const estimate = publishedDisplay(row, 1, false);
    if (estimate === "—" || estimate === "Suppressed" || isSuppressed(row)) return estimate;
    if (isMissing(row.ci_lower_value) || isMissing(row.ci_upper_value)) return estimate;
    const lower = Number(row.ci_lower_value);
    const upper = Number(row.ci_upper_value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(lower) || !Number.isFinite(upper)) return estimate;
    return `${estimate} (${lower.toFixed(1)}–${upper.toFixed(1)})`;
  }

  function percent(row) {
    const value = publishedDisplay(row, 1, false);
    if (value === "—" || value === "Suppressed" || isSuppressed(row)) return value;
    return `${value}%`;
  }

  // Display a current count followed by its matching previous-five-year mean.
  // The comparator is already published upstream; this helper does not calculate it.
  function countWithComparator(countRow, comparatorRow, integer = true) {
    const count = publishedDisplay(countRow, 0, integer);
    if (count === "—" || count === "Suppressed" || isSuppressed(countRow)) return count;
    const comparator = publishedDisplay(comparatorRow, 1, false);
    if (comparator === "—") return count;
    return `${count} (${comparator})`;
  }

  // Format a value taken directly from an approved fixed reference asset.
  // No reference statistic is calculated in the publication layer.
  function referenceDisplay(value, digits = 1, integer = false) {
    const number = Number(value);
    if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return "—";
    if (integer) return Math.round(number).toLocaleString("en-GB");
    return number.toFixed(digits);
  }

  function exact(data, where, label = "table cell") {
    const matches = data.filter(row =>
      Object.entries(where).every(([key, value]) => row[key] === value)
    );
    if (matches.length > 1) {
      throw new Error(`${label}: expected at most one published row but found ${matches.length}.`);
    }
    return matches.length === 1 ? matches[0] : null;
  }

  function uniqueYears(rows) {
    return [...new Set(rows.map(d => Number(d.period_year)).filter(Number.isFinite))]
      .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }

  function yearLabel(year, rows) {
    const incomplete = rows.some(d => Number(d.period_year) === Number(year) && Number(d.period_complete) === 0);
    return incomplete ? `${year} YTD` : String(year);
  }

  function periodLabel(row, periodType) {
    const year = Number(row.period_year);
    if (periodType === "quarterly") {
      const quarter = Number(row.period_quarter);
      return `${year} Q${quarter}${Number(row.period_complete) === 0 ? " (incomplete)" : ""}`;
    }
    if (periodType === "monthly") {
      const month = Number(row.period_month);
      const monthLabel = month >= 1 && month <= 12 ? monthNames[month - 1] : `M${month}`;
      return `${year} ${monthLabel}${Number(row.period_complete) === 0 ? " (incomplete)" : ""}`;
    }
    return yearLabel(year, [row]);
  }

  function periodKeys(rows, periodType) {
    const countRows = rows.filter(d => d.statistic === (periodType === "quarterly" ? "quarterly_count" : "monthly_count"));
    const seen = new Map();
    countRows.forEach(row => {
      const key = periodType === "quarterly"
        ? `${Number(row.period_year)}|${Number(row.period_quarter)}`
        : `${Number(row.period_year)}|${Number(row.period_month)}`;
      if (!seen.has(key)) seen.set(key, row);
    });
    return [...seen.values()].sort((a, b) => {
      const y = Number(a.period_year) - Number(b.period_year);
      if (y !== 0) return y;
      return periodType === "quarterly"
        ? Number(a.period_quarter) - Number(b.period_quarter)
        : Number(a.period_month) - Number(b.period_month);
    });
  }

  function makeTable(columns, rows, options = {}) {
    const container = document.createElement("div");

    const cellText = value => {
      if (value && typeof value === "object" && "text" in value) return value.text;
      return value === null || value === undefined || value === "" ? "—" : String(value);
    };

    if (options.downloadName) {
      const actions = document.createElement("div");
      actions.className = "bnr-table-actions";
      const download = document.createElement("a");
      download.className = "bnr-table-download";
      download.textContent = "Download table";
      download.setAttribute("download", options.downloadName);

      // Keep table downloads as ordinary rectangular CSV files while adding a
      // compact provenance tail. Detailed methodological metadata remain in the
      // approved release metadata referenced by source_metadata.
      const metadata = options.downloadMetadata ?? {};
      const metadataEntries = Object.entries(metadata);
      const escapeCsv = value => {
        const text = value === null || value === undefined ? "" : String(value);
        return /[",\n]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replaceAll('"', '""')}"` : text;
      };
      const csvRows = [
        [
          ...columns.map(column => escapeCsv(column.label)),
          ...metadataEntries.map(([key]) => escapeCsv(key))
        ].join(","),
        ...rows.map(row => [
          ...columns.map(column => escapeCsv(cellText(row[column.key]))),
          ...metadataEntries.map(([, value]) => escapeCsv(value))
        ].join(","))
      ];
      const blob = new Blob(["\ufeff" + csvRows.join("\n")], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"});
      download.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      actions.appendChild(download);
      container.appendChild(actions);
    }

    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "bnr-table-wrap";
    const table = document.createElement("table");
    table.className = "bnr-reference-table";
    if (options.ariaLabel) table.setAttribute("aria-label", options.ariaLabel);
    if (options.downloadGroup) table.dataset.downloadGroup = options.downloadGroup;
    if (options.downloadTab) table.dataset.downloadTab = options.downloadTab;
    if (options.downloadMetadata) table.dataset.downloadMetadata = JSON.stringify(options.downloadMetadata);

    const thead = document.createElement("thead");
    const headRow = document.createElement("tr");
    columns.forEach(column => {
      const th = document.createElement("th");
      th.textContent = column.label;
      if (column.numeric) th.classList.add("bnr-num");
      headRow.appendChild(th);
    });
    thead.appendChild(headRow);
    table.appendChild(thead);

    const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");

    function appendDataRow(row, hidden = false) {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (row._incomplete) tr.classList.add("bnr-incomplete-row");
      if (hidden) tr.hidden = true;
      columns.forEach(column => {
        const td = document.createElement("td");
        const value = row[column.key];
        const display = cellText(value);
        if (value && typeof value === "object" && "text" in value) {
          const span = document.createElement("span");
          span.textContent = display;
          if (value.className) span.className = value.className;
          if (value.title) span.title = value.title;
          td.appendChild(span);
        } else {
          td.textContent = display;
        }
        if (column.numeric) td.classList.add("bnr-num");
        if (display === "—") td.classList.add("bnr-missing");
        tr.appendChild(td);
      });
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
      return tr;
    }

    if (options.collapseByYear) {
      const years = [...new Set(rows.map(row => Number(row._year)).filter(Number.isFinite))]
        .sort((a, b) => a - b);
      // Open the two most recent years by default. This keeps recent periods
      // visible while older years remain compact and easy to expand.
      const defaultOpenYears = new Set(years.slice(-2));

      years.forEach(year => {
        const yearRows = rows.filter(row => Number(row._year) === year);
        const toggleRow = document.createElement("tr");
        toggleRow.className = "bnr-year-toggle-row";
        const toggleCell = document.createElement("td");
        toggleCell.colSpan = columns.length;
        const toggle = document.createElement("button");
        toggle.type = "button";
        toggle.className = "bnr-year-toggle";
        const renderedRows = [];
        let expanded = defaultOpenYears.has(year);

        function updateToggle() {
          toggle.textContent = `${expanded ? "▾" : "▸"} ${year}`;
          toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(expanded));
          toggleRow.classList.toggle("bnr-year-open", expanded);
          renderedRows.forEach(tr => { tr.hidden = !expanded; });
        }

        toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
          expanded = !expanded;
          updateToggle();
        });
        toggleCell.appendChild(toggle);
        toggleRow.appendChild(toggleCell);
        tbody.appendChild(toggleRow);
        yearRows.forEach(row => renderedRows.push(appendDataRow(row, !expanded)));
        updateToggle();
      });
    } else {
      rows.forEach(row => appendDataRow(row));
    }

    table.appendChild(tbody);
    wrap.appendChild(table);
    container.appendChild(wrap);
    return container;
  }

  // One-click download for a complete panel-tabset. The result is a single
  // long-format CSV (Tab, Row, Measure, Value) with the same compact provenance
  // fields carried by each individual tab download. This avoids a ZIP-library
  // dependency while keeping the release source attached to every record.
  function makeDownloadAllButton(group, downloadName) {
    const actions = document.createElement("div");
    actions.className = "bnr-table-group-actions";
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.className = "bnr-table-download-all";
    button.textContent = "Download all tabs (CSV)";

    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const selector = `table.bnr-reference-table[data-download-group="${group}"]`;
      const tables = [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)];
      if (!tables.length) {
        window.alert("The tab tables are not available yet. Please try again after the page has finished loading.");
        return;
      }

      const escapeCsv = value => {
        const text = value === null || value === undefined ? "" : String(value);
        return /[",\n]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replaceAll('"', '""')}"` : text;
      };

      const tableMetadata = tables.map(table => {
        try {
          return JSON.parse(table.dataset.downloadMetadata || "{}");
        } catch {
          return {};
        }
      });
      const metadataKeys = [...new Set(tableMetadata.flatMap(metadata => Object.keys(metadata)))];
      const records = [["Tab", "Row", "Measure", "Value", ...metadataKeys]];

      tables.forEach((table, tableIndex) => {
        const tab = table.dataset.downloadTab || table.getAttribute("aria-label") || "Table";
        const metadata = tableMetadata[tableIndex];
        const headers = [...table.querySelectorAll("thead th")].map(th => th.textContent.trim());
        [...table.querySelectorAll("tbody tr:not(.bnr-year-toggle-row)")].forEach(tr => {
          const cells = [...tr.querySelectorAll("td")].map(td => td.textContent.trim());
          const rowLabel = cells[0] ?? "";
          for (let i = 1; i < cells.length; i++) {
            records.push([
              tab,
              rowLabel,
              headers[i] ?? `Column ${i + 1}`,
              cells[i] ?? "",
              ...metadataKeys.map(key => metadata[key] ?? "")
            ]);
          }
        });
      });

      const csv = records.map(record => record.map(escapeCsv).join(",")).join("\n");
      const blob = new Blob(["\ufeff" + csv], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"});
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = url;
      link.download = downloadName;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      link.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    });

    actions.appendChild(button);
    return actions;
  }

  function releaseId(data) {
    const ids = [...new Set(data.map(d => d.release_id).filter(d => !isMissing(d)))];
    if (ids.length !== 1) throw new Error(`Expected one release_id in current public dataset; found ${ids.length}.`);
    return ids[0];
  }

  function coverageText(rows) {
    const years = uniqueYears(rows);
    if (!years.length) return "Not available";
    const first = years[0];
    const last = years[years.length - 1];
    const incomplete = rows.some(d => Number(d.period_year) === last && Number(d.period_complete) === 0);
    return incomplete ? `${first}–${last} (${last} YTD)` : `${first}–${last}`;
  }

  // Helpers used only by the two dashboard-aligned quality calculations.
  function completeSafeNumber(row) {
    if (!row || Number(row.period_complete) !== 1 || isSuppressed(row) || isMissing(row.value)) return null;
    const value = Number(row.value);
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
  }

  function qualityCell(share, thresholds, title) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(share)) return {text: "—", className: "bnr-quality-unavailable"};
    const rounded = Math.round(share);
    const level = rounded < thresholds.lowMax ? "low" : rounded < thresholds.mediumMax ? "medium" : "high";
    return {text: `${rounded}%`, className: `bnr-quality-value bnr-quality-${level}`, title};
  }

  function sourceCard(title, release, countCoverage, rateCoverage) {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "bnr-source-card";
    const heading = document.createElement("div");
    heading.className = "bnr-source-title";
    heading.textContent = title;
    card.appendChild(heading);
    [["Release", release], ["Counts / %", countCoverage], ["Annual rates", rateCoverage]].forEach(([label, value]) => {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "bnr-source-row";
      const l = document.createElement("div");
      l.className = "bnr-source-label";
      l.textContent = label;
      const v = document.createElement("div");
      v.textContent = value;
      row.append(l, v);
      card.appendChild(row);
    });
    return card;
  }

  return {
    exact,
    uniqueYears,
    yearLabel,
    periodLabel,
    periodKeys,
    publishedDisplay,
    rateWithCI,
    percent,
    countWithComparator,
    referenceDisplay,
    makeTable,
    makeDownloadAllButton,
    releaseId,
    coverageText,
    completeSafeNumber,
    qualityCell,
    sourceCard
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// EVENT TABLE DEFINITIONS (E1-E8)
// E1 annual hospital-only counts
// E2 annual national hospital + DCO counts
// E3 quarterly hospital-only counts + published rolling 5-year comparator
// E4 monthly All-CVD hospital-only counts + fixed 2015-2019 min/mean/max reference
// E5 distributions
// E6 crude national event rates
// E7 age-standardised national event rates
// E8 DCO-dependence quality table
eventViews = {
  const definitions = {primary: "primary", inclusive: "inclusive"};
  const sexes = [["all", "both"], ["female", "women"], ["male", "men"]];
  const eventRelease = tableUtils.releaseId(eventMetrics);
  const eventDataset = "site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/cvd_metrics_current.csv";
  const eventMetadata = `site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/catalogue/${eventRelease}.yml`;

  // Standard provenance attached to every event-table CSV download. The values
  // repeat by row deliberately so a detached CSV remains self-describing.
  function downloadMetadata(tableId, metricId, statistic, scope, extra = {}) {
    return {
      table_id: tableId,
      source_release_id: eventRelease,
      source_metric_id: metricId,
      source_statistic: statistic,
      source_dataset: eventDataset,
      source_metadata: eventMetadata,
      source_scope: scope,
      reference_asset: "",
      derived_in_tabulations: "no",
      derivation: "",
      ...extra
    };
  }

  const hospitalRows = eventMetrics.filter(d =>
    d.source_status === "hospital_registered" &&
    d.ascertainment_scope === "hospital_only" &&
    d.mortality_definition === "not_applicable" &&
    d.estimate_basis === "observed"
  );

  const annualHospitalCounts = hospitalRows.filter(d =>
    d.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-001" && d.period_type === "annual" &&
    d.statistic === "annual_count" && d.age_group === "all"
  );

  const distributionRows = hospitalRows.filter(d =>
    d.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-002" && d.period_type === "annual"
  );

  const nationalAnnualCounts = eventMetrics.filter(d =>
    d.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-001" && d.period_type === "annual" &&
    d.statistic === "annual_count" && d.age_group === "all" && d.sex === "all" &&
    d.source_status === "national_estimate" && d.ascertainment_scope === "hospital_plus_dco" &&
    d.estimate_basis === "estimated"
  );

  const nationalRateRows = eventMetrics.filter(d =>
    d.metric_id === "CVD-INCIDENCE-001" && d.period_type === "annual" &&
    d.source_status === "national_estimate" && d.ascertainment_scope === "hospital_plus_dco" &&
    d.estimate_basis === "estimated"
  );

  // TABLE E1: Annual hospital-recorded event counts (hospital only).
  function annualHospitalCountTable(eventType) {
    const source = annualHospitalCounts.filter(d => d.event_type === eventType);
    const years = tableUtils.uniqueYears(source);
    const rows = years.map(year => {
      const row = {
        year: tableUtils.yearLabel(year, source),
        _incomplete: source.some(d => Number(d.period_year) === year && Number(d.period_complete) === 0)
      };
      sexes.forEach(([sex, key]) => {
        row[key] = tableUtils.publishedDisplay(
          tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, sex}, `annual hospital event count: ${eventType}, ${sex}`),
          0, true
        );
      });
      return row;
    });
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "year", label: "Year"},
      {key: "both", label: "Both sexes", numeric: true},
      {key: "women", label: "Women", numeric: true},
      {key: "men", label: "Men", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: `${eventType} annual hospital-only event counts`,
      downloadName: `cvd_event_annual_hospital_only_${eventType}_${eventRelease}.csv`,
      downloadGroup: "event-annual-hospital",
      downloadTab: eventType === "all_cvd" ? "All CVD" : eventType === "heart" ? "Heart" : "Stroke",
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        `event_annual_hospital_counts_${eventType}`,
        "CVD-BURDEN-001",
        "annual_count",
        "hospital_only"
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLE E2: Annual national event estimates including hospital + DCO events.
  // The two tabs are the approved Primary and Inclusive national estimates.
  function annualNationalCountTable(definitionKey) {
    const definition = definitions[definitionKey];
    if (!definition) throw new Error(`Unknown event definition: ${definitionKey}`);
    const source = nationalAnnualCounts.filter(d => d.mortality_definition === definition);
    const years = tableUtils.uniqueYears(source);
    const eventTypes = [["all_cvd", "All CVD"], ["heart", "Heart"], ["stroke", "Stroke"]];
    const rows = years.map(year => {
      const row = {
        year: tableUtils.yearLabel(year, source),
        _incomplete: source.some(d => Number(d.period_year) === year && Number(d.period_complete) === 0)
      };
      eventTypes.forEach(([eventType]) => {
        row[eventType] = tableUtils.publishedDisplay(
          tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, event_type: eventType}, `annual national event count: ${definitionKey}, ${eventType}`),
          1, false
        );
      });
      return row;
    });
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "year", label: "Year"},
      {key: "all_cvd", label: "All CVD", numeric: true},
      {key: "heart", label: "Heart", numeric: true},
      {key: "stroke", label: "Stroke", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: `Annual national event estimates, hospital plus DCO, ${definitionKey}`,
      downloadName: `cvd_event_annual_national_hospital_plus_dco_${definitionKey}_${eventRelease}.csv`,
      downloadGroup: "event-annual-national",
      downloadTab: definitionKey === "primary" ? "Primary" : "Inclusive",
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        `event_annual_national_counts_${definitionKey}`,
        "CVD-BURDEN-001",
        "annual_count",
        "hospital_plus_dco"
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLE E3: Quarterly hospital counts with the matching published rolling
  // previous-five-year mean in brackets. No comparator is calculated here.
  function periodHospitalCountTable(eventType, periodType) {
    if (periodType !== "quarterly") {
      throw new Error("periodHospitalCountTable is restricted to quarterly event tables.");
    }
    const countStatistic = "quarterly_count";
    const comparatorStatistic = "quarterly_same_quarter_previous_5yr_mean";

    const source = hospitalRows.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-001" && d.period_type === "quarterly" &&
      d.event_type === eventType && d.age_group === "all" &&
      [countStatistic, comparatorStatistic].includes(d.statistic)
    );
    const periods = tableUtils.periodKeys(source, "quarterly");

    const rows = periods.map(period => {
      const keyWhere = {period_year: period.period_year, period_quarter: period.period_quarter};
      const row = {
        period: tableUtils.periodLabel(period, "quarterly"),
        _year: Number(period.period_year),
        _incomplete: Number(period.period_complete) === 0
      };
      sexes.forEach(([sex, key]) => {
        const count = tableUtils.exact(source, {...keyWhere, sex, statistic: countStatistic}, `quarterly event count: ${eventType}, ${sex}`);
        const comparator = tableUtils.exact(source, {...keyWhere, sex, statistic: comparatorStatistic}, `quarterly event comparator: ${eventType}, ${sex}`);
        row[key] = tableUtils.countWithComparator(count, comparator, true);
      });
      return row;
    });

    const label = eventType === "all_cvd" ? "All CVD" : eventType === "heart" ? "Heart" : "Stroke";
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "period", label: "Quarter"},
      {key: "both", label: "Both sexes", numeric: true},
      {key: "women", label: "Women", numeric: true},
      {key: "men", label: "Men", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: `${label} quarterly hospital-only event counts with five-year comparator`,
      downloadName: `cvd_event_quarterly_hospital_only_${eventType}_${eventRelease}.csv`,
      downloadGroup: "event-quarterly-hospital",
      downloadTab: label,
      collapseByYear: true,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        `event_quarterly_hospital_counts_${eventType}`,
        "CVD-BURDEN-001",
        "quarterly_count;quarterly_same_quarter_previous_5yr_mean",
        "hospital_only"
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLE E4: Monthly public event lattice. The approved workflow deliberately
  // publishes only All CVD, both sexes, all ages at monthly resolution.
  // The fixed 2015-2019 monthly reference is also already approved upstream.
  function monthlyHospitalCountTable() {
    const source = hospitalRows.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-001" && d.period_type === "monthly" &&
      d.statistic === "monthly_count" && d.event_type === "all_cvd" &&
      d.sex === "all" && d.age_group === "all"
    );
    const periods = tableUtils.periodKeys(source, "monthly");

    const rows = periods.map(period => {
      const count = tableUtils.exact(source, {
        period_year: period.period_year,
        period_month: period.period_month,
        sex: "all",
        statistic: "monthly_count"
      }, `monthly event count: ${period.period_year}-${period.period_month}`);
      const reference = tableUtils.exact(eventMonthlyReference, {
        ascertainment_scope: "hospital_only",
        event_type: "all_cvd",
        sex: "all",
        age_group: "all",
        period_month: Number(period.period_month)
      }, `event monthly 2015-2019 reference: month ${period.period_month}`);

      return {
        period: tableUtils.periodLabel(period, "monthly"),
        count: tableUtils.publishedDisplay(count, 0, true),
        reference_min: tableUtils.referenceDisplay(reference?.reference_min, 0, true),
        reference_mean: tableUtils.referenceDisplay(reference?.reference_mean, 1, false),
        reference_max: tableUtils.referenceDisplay(reference?.reference_max, 0, true),
        _year: Number(period.period_year),
        _incomplete: Number(period.period_complete) === 0
      };
    });

    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "period", label: "Month"},
      {key: "count", label: "All CVD, both sexes", numeric: true},
      {key: "reference_min", label: "2015-2019 min", numeric: true},
      {key: "reference_mean", label: "2015-2019 average", numeric: true},
      {key: "reference_max", label: "2015-2019 max", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: "Monthly All CVD hospital-only event counts with fixed 2015-2019 reference",
      downloadName: `cvd_event_monthly_hospital_only_all_cvd_${eventRelease}.csv`,
      collapseByYear: true,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        "event_monthly_hospital_counts_all_cvd",
        "CVD-BURDEN-001",
        "monthly_count",
        "hospital_only",
        {reference_asset: "site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/cvd_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv"}
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLE E5: Distribution of hospital-recorded CVD events.
  function distributionTable(kind) {
    let specification;
    if (kind === "event_type") {
      specification = {statistic: "event_type_distribution", columns: [["heart", "Heart"], ["stroke", "Stroke"]], where: {sex: "all", age_group: "all"}, dimension: "event_type"};
    } else if (kind === "age") {
      specification = {statistic: "age_distribution", columns: [["under_70", "Under 70"], ["age_70_plus", "70 and over"]], where: {event_type: "all_cvd", sex: "all"}, dimension: "age_group"};
    } else {
      specification = {statistic: "sex_distribution", columns: [["female", "Women"], ["male", "Men"]], where: {event_type: "all_cvd", age_group: "all"}, dimension: "sex"};
    }
    const source = distributionRows.filter(d =>
      d.statistic === specification.statistic &&
      Object.entries(specification.where).every(([key, value]) => d[key] === value)
    );
    const years = tableUtils.uniqueYears(source);
    const rows = years.map(year => {
      const row = {year: tableUtils.yearLabel(year, source), _incomplete: source.some(d => Number(d.period_year) === year && Number(d.period_complete) === 0)};
      specification.columns.forEach(([value, label], index) => {
        const match = tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, [specification.dimension]: value}, `event distribution: ${label}`);
        row[`v${index}`] = tableUtils.percent(match);
      });
      return row;
    });
    const tabLabel = kind === "event_type" ? "Event type" : kind === "age" ? "Age" : "Sex";
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "year", label: "Year"},
      ...specification.columns.map(([, label], index) => ({key: `v${index}`, label, numeric: true}))
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: `CVD event ${kind} distribution`,
      downloadName: `cvd_event_distribution_${kind}_${eventRelease}.csv`,
      downloadGroup: "event-distribution",
      downloadTab: tabLabel,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        `event_distribution_${kind}`,
        "CVD-BURDEN-002",
        specification.statistic,
        "hospital_only"
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLES E6-E7: National event rates including hospital + DCO estimates.
  // Tabs select event type and Primary/Inclusive definition; columns remain sex only.
  function rateTable(eventType, rateType, definitionKey) {
    const definition = definitions[definitionKey];
    if (!definition) throw new Error(`Unknown event definition: ${definitionKey}`);
    const source = nationalRateRows.filter(d => d.event_type === eventType && d.mortality_definition === definition);
    const years = tableUtils.uniqueYears(source);
    const ageGroup = rateType === "crude" ? "all" : "age_standardised";
    const statistic = rateType === "crude" ? "annual_crude_rate" : "annual_age_standardised_rate";
    const rows = years.map(year => {
      const row = {year: String(year), _incomplete: false};
      sexes.forEach(([sex, key]) => {
        row[key] = tableUtils.rateWithCI(tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, sex, age_group: ageGroup, statistic}, `event ${rateType} national rate: ${definitionKey}, ${sex}`));
      });
      return row;
    });
    const eventLabel = eventType === "all_cvd" ? "All CVD" : eventType === "heart" ? "Heart" : "Stroke";
    const definitionLabel = definitionKey === "primary" ? "Primary" : "Inclusive";
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "year", label: "Year"},
      {key: "both", label: "Both sexes", numeric: true},
      {key: "women", label: "Women", numeric: true},
      {key: "men", label: "Men", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: `${eventLabel} annual ${rateType} national event rates, ${definitionLabel}`,
      downloadName: `cvd_event_${rateType}_national_rates_${eventType}_${definitionKey}_${eventRelease}.csv`,
      downloadGroup: `event-rate-${rateType}`,
      downloadTab: `${eventLabel} - ${definitionLabel}`,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        `event_${rateType}_national_rates_${eventType}_${definitionKey}`,
        "CVD-INCIDENCE-001",
        statistic,
        "hospital_plus_dco"
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLE E8: How much does the national event estimate rely on DCO events?
  // Approved dashboard-aligned calculation:
  //   DCO share = 100 * additional DCO / Primary hospital + DCO estimate.
  function dcoQualityTable() {
    const source = eventMetrics.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "CVD-BURDEN-001" && d.period_type === "annual" &&
      d.statistic === "annual_count" && d.sex === "all" && d.age_group === "all"
    );
    const eventTypes = [["all_cvd", "All CVD"], ["heart", "Heart"], ["stroke", "Stroke"]];
    const years = tableUtils.uniqueYears(source);
    const thresholds = {lowMax: 10, mediumMax: 15};
    const rows = years.map(year => {
      const row = {year: String(year), _incomplete: false};
      eventTypes.forEach(([eventType, label]) => {
        const dcoRow = tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, event_type: eventType, ascertainment_scope: "additional_dco", mortality_definition: "primary"}, `DCO dependence: ${eventType}, additional DCO`);
        const totalRow = tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, event_type: eventType, ascertainment_scope: "hospital_plus_dco", mortality_definition: "primary"}, `DCO dependence: ${eventType}, hospital plus DCO`);
        const hospitalRow = tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, event_type: eventType, ascertainment_scope: "hospital_only", mortality_definition: "not_applicable"}, `DCO dependence: ${eventType}, hospital only`);
        const dco = tableUtils.completeSafeNumber(dcoRow);
        const total = tableUtils.completeSafeNumber(totalRow);
        const hospital = tableUtils.completeSafeNumber(hospitalRow);
        if (dco === null || total === null || hospital === null || total <= 0 || dco < 0) {
          row[eventType] = {text: "—", className: "bnr-quality-unavailable"};
          return;
        }
        const share = 100 * dco / total;
        row[eventType] = tableUtils.qualityCell(share, thresholds, `${label}, ${year}: DCO ${dco.toFixed(1)}; hospital ${hospital.toFixed(1)}; Primary hospital + DCO estimate ${total.toFixed(1)}.`);
      });
      return row;
    }).filter(row => eventTypes.some(([eventType]) => row[eventType]?.text !== "—"));
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "year", label: "Year"},
      {key: "all_cvd", label: "All CVD", numeric: true},
      {key: "heart", label: "Heart", numeric: true},
      {key: "stroke", label: "Stroke", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: "DCO events as a percentage of the Primary national event estimate",
      downloadName: `cvd_event_dco_dependence_${eventRelease}.csv`,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        "event_dco_dependence",
        "CVD-BURDEN-001",
        "annual_count",
        "hospital_only;additional_dco;hospital_plus_dco",
        {
          derived_in_tabulations: "yes",
          derivation: "100 * additional DCO / Primary hospital + DCO estimate"
        }
      )
    });
  }

  return {
    annualHospitalCountTable,
    annualNationalCountTable,
    periodHospitalCountTable,
    monthlyHospitalCountTable,
    distributionTable,
    rateTable,
    dcoQualityTable,
    release: eventRelease,
    countCoverage: tableUtils.coverageText(annualHospitalCounts),
    rateCoverage: tableUtils.coverageText(nationalRateRows)
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// MORTALITY TABLE DEFINITIONS (M1-M7)
// M1 annual death counts
// M2 quarterly death counts + published rolling 5-year comparator
// M3 monthly All-CVD death counts + fixed 2015-2019 min/mean/max reference
// M4 distributions
// M5 crude mortality rates
// M6 age-standardised mortality rates
// M7 Possible-death dependence quality table
mortalityViews = {
  const definitions = {primary: "primary_clear_likely", inclusive: "upper_clear_likely_possible"};
  const sexes = [["all", "both"], ["female", "women"], ["male", "men"]];
  const mortalityRelease = tableUtils.releaseId(mortalityMetrics);
  const mortalityDataset = "site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.csv";
  const mortalityMetadata = `site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/catalogue/${mortalityRelease}.yml`;

  // Standard provenance attached to every mortality-table CSV download.
  function downloadMetadata(tableId, metricId, statistic, scope, extra = {}) {
    return {
      table_id: tableId,
      source_release_id: mortalityRelease,
      source_metric_id: metricId,
      source_statistic: statistic,
      source_dataset: mortalityDataset,
      source_metadata: mortalityMetadata,
      source_scope: scope,
      reference_asset: "",
      derived_in_tabulations: "no",
      derivation: "",
      ...extra
    };
  }

  const publicRows = mortalityMetrics.filter(d => d.source_status === "death_certificate");
  const publicAnnual = publicRows.filter(d => d.period_type === "annual");
  const countRows = publicAnnual.filter(d => d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" && d.statistic === "annual_count" && d.age_group === "all");
  const distributionRows = publicAnnual.filter(d => d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-002");
  const rateRows = publicAnnual.filter(d => d.metric_id === "MORT-RATE-001");

  // TABLE M1: Annual CVD death counts.
  function countTable(eventType) {
    const source = countRows.filter(d => d.event_type === eventType);
    const years = tableUtils.uniqueYears(source);
    const rows = years.map(year => {
      const row = {year: tableUtils.yearLabel(year, source), _incomplete: source.some(d => Number(d.period_year) === year && Number(d.period_complete) === 0)};
      Object.entries(definitions).forEach(([definitionKey, definitionValue]) => {
        sexes.forEach(([sex, sexKey]) => {
          const match = tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, case_definition: definitionValue, sex}, `mortality count: ${definitionKey}, ${sex}`);
          row[`${definitionKey}_${sexKey}`] = tableUtils.publishedDisplay(match, 0, true);
        });
      });
      return row;
    });
    const eventLabel = eventType === "all_cvd" ? "All CVD" : eventType === "heart" ? "Heart" : "Stroke";
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "year", label: "Year"},
      {key: "primary_both", label: "Primary: Both sexes", numeric: true},
      {key: "primary_women", label: "Primary: Women", numeric: true},
      {key: "primary_men", label: "Primary: Men", numeric: true},
      {key: "inclusive_both", label: "Inclusive: Both sexes", numeric: true},
      {key: "inclusive_women", label: "Inclusive: Women", numeric: true},
      {key: "inclusive_men", label: "Inclusive: Men", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: `${eventLabel} annual CVD death counts`,
      downloadName: `cvd_mortality_counts_${eventType}_${mortalityRelease}.csv`,
      downloadGroup: "mortality-annual-counts",
      downloadTab: eventLabel,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        `mortality_annual_counts_${eventType}`,
        "MORT-BURDEN-001",
        "annual_count",
        "death_certificate"
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLE M2: Quarterly death counts with the matching published rolling
  // previous-five-year mean in brackets. Tabs select event type + definition.
  function periodCountTable(eventType, periodType, definitionKey) {
    if (periodType !== "quarterly") {
      throw new Error("periodCountTable is restricted to quarterly mortality tables.");
    }
    const definition = definitions[definitionKey];
    if (!definition) throw new Error(`Unknown mortality definition: ${definitionKey}`);
    const countStatistic = "quarterly_count";
    const comparatorStatistic = "quarterly_same_quarter_previous_5yr_mean";

    const source = publicRows.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" && d.period_type === "quarterly" &&
      d.event_type === eventType && d.age_group === "all" && d.case_definition === definition &&
      [countStatistic, comparatorStatistic].includes(d.statistic)
    );
    const periods = tableUtils.periodKeys(source, "quarterly");

    const rows = periods.map(period => {
      const keyWhere = {period_year: period.period_year, period_quarter: period.period_quarter};
      const row = {
        period: tableUtils.periodLabel(period, "quarterly"),
        _year: Number(period.period_year),
        _incomplete: Number(period.period_complete) === 0
      };

      sexes.forEach(([sex, key]) => {
        const count = tableUtils.exact(source, {...keyWhere, sex, statistic: countStatistic}, `quarterly mortality count: ${eventType}, ${definitionKey}, ${sex}`);
        const comparator = tableUtils.exact(source, {...keyWhere, sex, statistic: comparatorStatistic}, `quarterly mortality comparator: ${eventType}, ${definitionKey}, ${sex}`);
        row[key] = tableUtils.countWithComparator(count, comparator, true);
      });
      return row;
    });

    const eventLabel = eventType === "all_cvd" ? "All CVD" : eventType === "heart" ? "Heart" : "Stroke";
    const definitionLabel = definitionKey === "primary" ? "Primary" : "Inclusive";
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "period", label: "Quarter"},
      {key: "both", label: "Both sexes", numeric: true},
      {key: "women", label: "Women", numeric: true},
      {key: "men", label: "Men", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: `${eventLabel} quarterly CVD death counts, ${definitionLabel}`,
      downloadName: `cvd_mortality_quarterly_${eventType}_${definitionKey}_${mortalityRelease}.csv`,
      downloadGroup: "mortality-quarterly-counts",
      downloadTab: `${eventLabel} - ${definitionLabel}`,
      collapseByYear: true,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        `mortality_quarterly_counts_${eventType}_${definitionKey}`,
        "MORT-BURDEN-001",
        "quarterly_count;quarterly_same_quarter_previous_5yr_mean",
        "death_certificate"
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLE M3: Monthly mortality publication is deliberately restricted to
  // All CVD, both sexes, all ages. The approved reference contains definition-
  // specific fixed 2015-2019 minimum, mean and maximum values by calendar month.
  function monthlyCountTable(definitionKey) {
    const definition = definitions[definitionKey];
    if (!definition) throw new Error(`Unknown mortality definition: ${definitionKey}`);
    const source = publicRows.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" && d.period_type === "monthly" &&
      d.event_type === "all_cvd" && d.sex === "all" && d.age_group === "all" &&
      d.case_definition === definition && d.statistic === "monthly_count"
    );
    const periods = tableUtils.periodKeys(source, "monthly");

    const rows = periods.map(period => {
      const count = tableUtils.exact(source, {
        period_year: period.period_year,
        period_month: period.period_month,
        sex: "all",
        statistic: "monthly_count"
      }, `monthly mortality count: ${definitionKey}, ${period.period_year}-${period.period_month}`);
      const reference = tableUtils.exact(mortalityMonthlyReference, {
        case_definition: definition,
        event_type: "all_cvd",
        sex: "all",
        age_group: "all",
        period_month: Number(period.period_month)
      }, `mortality monthly 2015-2019 reference: ${definitionKey}, month ${period.period_month}`);

      return {
        period: tableUtils.periodLabel(period, "monthly"),
        count: tableUtils.publishedDisplay(count, 0, true),
        reference_min: tableUtils.referenceDisplay(reference?.reference_min, 0, true),
        reference_mean: tableUtils.referenceDisplay(reference?.reference_mean, 1, false),
        reference_max: tableUtils.referenceDisplay(reference?.reference_max, 0, true),
        _year: Number(period.period_year),
        _incomplete: Number(period.period_complete) === 0
      };
    });

    const definitionLabel = definitionKey === "primary" ? "Primary" : "Inclusive";
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "period", label: "Month"},
      {key: "count", label: "All CVD, both sexes", numeric: true},
      {key: "reference_min", label: "2015-2019 min", numeric: true},
      {key: "reference_mean", label: "2015-2019 average", numeric: true},
      {key: "reference_max", label: "2015-2019 max", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: `Monthly All CVD death counts, both sexes, ${definitionLabel}`,
      downloadName: `cvd_mortality_monthly_all_cvd_${definitionKey}_${mortalityRelease}.csv`,
      downloadGroup: "mortality-monthly-counts",
      downloadTab: definitionLabel,
      collapseByYear: true,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        `mortality_monthly_counts_all_cvd_${definitionKey}`,
        "MORT-BURDEN-001",
        "monthly_count",
        "death_certificate",
        {reference_asset: "site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv"}
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLE M4: Distribution of CVD deaths.
  function distributionTable(kind) {
    let specification;
    if (kind === "event_type") {
      specification = {statistic: "event_type_distribution", columns: [["heart", "Heart"], ["stroke", "Stroke"]], where: {sex: "all", age_group: "all"}, dimension: "event_type"};
    } else if (kind === "age") {
      specification = {statistic: "age_distribution", columns: [["under_70", "Under 70"], ["age_70_plus", "70 and over"]], where: {event_type: "all_cvd", sex: "all"}, dimension: "age_group"};
    } else {
      specification = {statistic: "sex_distribution", columns: [["female", "Women"], ["male", "Men"]], where: {event_type: "all_cvd", age_group: "all"}, dimension: "sex"};
    }
    const source = distributionRows.filter(d => d.statistic === specification.statistic && Object.entries(specification.where).every(([key, value]) => d[key] === value));
    const years = tableUtils.uniqueYears(source);
    const rows = years.map(year => {
      const row = {year: tableUtils.yearLabel(year, source), _incomplete: source.some(d => Number(d.period_year) === year && Number(d.period_complete) === 0)};
      Object.entries(definitions).forEach(([definitionKey, definitionValue]) => {
        specification.columns.forEach(([value, label], index) => {
          const match = tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, case_definition: definitionValue, [specification.dimension]: value}, `mortality distribution: ${definitionKey}, ${label}`);
          row[`${definitionKey}_${index}`] = tableUtils.percent(match);
        });
      });
      return row;
    });
    const tabLabel = kind === "event_type" ? "Event type" : kind === "age" ? "Age" : "Sex";
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "year", label: "Year"},
      {key: "primary_0", label: `Primary: ${specification.columns[0][1]}`, numeric: true},
      {key: "primary_1", label: `Primary: ${specification.columns[1][1]}`, numeric: true},
      {key: "inclusive_0", label: `Inclusive: ${specification.columns[0][1]}`, numeric: true},
      {key: "inclusive_1", label: `Inclusive: ${specification.columns[1][1]}`, numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: `CVD mortality ${kind} distribution`,
      downloadName: `cvd_mortality_distribution_${kind}_${mortalityRelease}.csv`,
      downloadGroup: "mortality-distribution",
      downloadTab: tabLabel,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        `mortality_distribution_${kind}`,
        "MORT-BURDEN-002",
        specification.statistic,
        "death_certificate"
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLES M5-M6: Annual crude and age-standardised mortality rates.
  function rateTable(eventType, rateType, definitionKey) {
    const definitionValue = definitions[definitionKey];
    if (!definitionValue) throw new Error(`Unknown mortality definition: ${definitionKey}`);
    const source = rateRows.filter(d => d.event_type === eventType);
    const years = tableUtils.uniqueYears(source);
    const ageGroup = rateType === "crude" ? "all" : "age_standardised";
    const statistic = rateType === "crude" ? "annual_crude_rate" : "annual_age_standardised_rate";
    const rows = years.map(year => {
      const row = {year: String(year), _incomplete: false};
      sexes.forEach(([sex, sexKey]) => {
        row[sexKey] = tableUtils.rateWithCI(tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, sex, case_definition: definitionValue, age_group: ageGroup, statistic}, `mortality ${rateType} rate: ${definitionKey}, ${sex}`));
      });
      return row;
    });
    const eventLabel = eventType === "all_cvd" ? "All CVD" : eventType === "heart" ? "Heart" : "Stroke";
    const definitionLabel = definitionKey === "primary" ? "Primary" : "Inclusive";
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "year", label: "Year"},
      {key: "both", label: "Both sexes", numeric: true},
      {key: "women", label: "Women", numeric: true},
      {key: "men", label: "Men", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: `${eventLabel} annual ${rateType} CVD mortality rates, ${definitionLabel}`,
      downloadName: `cvd_mortality_${rateType}_rates_${eventType}_${definitionKey}_${mortalityRelease}.csv`,
      downloadGroup: `mortality-rate-${rateType}`,
      downloadTab: `${eventLabel} - ${definitionLabel}`,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        `mortality_${rateType}_rates_${eventType}_${definitionKey}`,
        "MORT-RATE-001",
        statistic,
        "death_certificate"
      )
    });
  }

  // TABLE M7: How much does the estimate rely on Possible deaths?
  // Approved dashboard-aligned calculation:
  //   Possible share = 100 * (Inclusive - Primary) / Inclusive.
  function possibleQualityTable() {
    const source = mortalityMetrics.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" && d.period_type === "annual" &&
      d.statistic === "annual_count" && d.sex === "all" && d.age_group === "all" &&
      d.source_status === "death_certificate"
    );
    const eventTypes = [["all_cvd", "All CVD"], ["heart", "Heart"], ["stroke", "Stroke"]];
    const years = tableUtils.uniqueYears(source);
    const thresholds = {lowMax: 20, mediumMax: 30};
    const rows = years.map(year => {
      const row = {year: String(year), _incomplete: false};
      eventTypes.forEach(([eventType, label]) => {
        const primaryRow = tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, event_type: eventType, case_definition: definitions.primary}, `Possible-death dependence: ${eventType}, Primary`);
        const inclusiveRow = tableUtils.exact(source, {period_year: year, event_type: eventType, case_definition: definitions.inclusive}, `Possible-death dependence: ${eventType}, Inclusive`);
        const primary = tableUtils.completeSafeNumber(primaryRow);
        const inclusive = tableUtils.completeSafeNumber(inclusiveRow);
        if (primary === null || inclusive === null || inclusive <= 0) {
          row[eventType] = {text: "—", className: "bnr-quality-unavailable"};
          return;
        }
        const possible = inclusive - primary;
        if (!Number.isFinite(possible) || possible < 0) {
          row[eventType] = {text: "—", className: "bnr-quality-unavailable"};
          return;
        }
        const share = 100 * possible / inclusive;
        row[eventType] = tableUtils.qualityCell(share, thresholds, `${label}, ${year}: Inclusive ${inclusive.toFixed(1)}; Primary ${primary.toFixed(1)}; Possible ${possible.toFixed(1)}.`);
      });
      return row;
    }).filter(row => eventTypes.some(([eventType]) => row[eventType]?.text !== "—"));
    return tableUtils.makeTable([
      {key: "year", label: "Year"},
      {key: "all_cvd", label: "All CVD", numeric: true},
      {key: "heart", label: "Heart", numeric: true},
      {key: "stroke", label: "Stroke", numeric: true}
    ], rows, {
      ariaLabel: "Possible deaths as a percentage of the Inclusive annual CVD death estimate",
      downloadName: `cvd_mortality_possible_dependence_${mortalityRelease}.csv`,
      downloadMetadata: downloadMetadata(
        "mortality_possible_dependence",
        "MORT-BURDEN-001",
        "annual_count",
        "death_certificate",
        {
          derived_in_tabulations: "yes",
          derivation: "100 * (Inclusive - Primary) / Inclusive"
        }
      )
    });
  }

  return {
    countTable,
    periodCountTable,
    monthlyCountTable,
    distributionTable,
    rateTable,
    possibleQualityTable,
    release: mortalityRelease,
    countCoverage: tableUtils.coverageText(countRows),
    rateCoverage: tableUtils.coverageText(rateRows)
  };
}
```

<div class="bnr-quality-key">
  <span class="bnr-quality-key-item"><span class="bnr-quality-swatch bnr-quality-swatch-low"></span><strong>Lower:</strong> &lt;10%</span>

</div>

<div class="bnr-table-note"><strong>Technical note:</strong> This reproduces the events-dashboard calculation: additional DCO events divided by the Primary hospital + DCO estimate, multiplied by 100. Values are calculated only when the DCO, hospital-only and total source rows are complete, unsuppressed and numeric. It is an ascertainment-dependence indicator, not a separate published CVD metric.</div>

<div class="bnr-table-note"><strong>Technical note:</strong> The approved monthly mortality lattice is intentionally limited to All CVD, both sexes and all ages. The reference columns are the approved definition-specific 2015-2019 same-calendar-month minimum, mean and maximum; they are fixed reference values rather than rolling five-year comparators. Primary includes Clear or Likely CVD deaths; Inclusive additionally includes Possible deaths. Years can be expanded or collapsed within each tab; the latest year opens by default.</div>

### How much does the estimate rely on Possible deaths?

This table shows how much the Inclusive mortality estimate depends on deaths classified as Possible CVD.

```{ojs}
mortalityViews.possibleQualityTable()
```

<div class="bnr-quality-key">
  <span class="bnr-quality-key-item"><span class="bnr-quality-swatch bnr-quality-swatch-low"></span><strong>Lower:</strong> &lt;20%</span>
  <span class="bnr-quality-key-item"><span class="bnr-quality-swatch bnr-quality-swatch-medium"></span><strong>Moderate:</strong> 20–29%</span>
  <span class="bnr-quality-key-item"><span class="bnr-quality-swatch bnr-quality-swatch-high"></span><strong>Higher:</strong> 30%+</span>
</div>

<div class="bnr-table-note"><strong>Technical note:</strong> This reproduces the mortality-dashboard calculation: (Inclusive deaths − Primary deaths) divided by Inclusive deaths, multiplied by 100. Values are calculated only from complete, unsuppressed annual counts. Mortality cause information was stored together for 2010–2017 and certificate lines are stored separately from 2018 onward.</div>
